content.value_statement: Generative art requests often need structure, reproducibility, and interactive exploration. This skill turns a creative brief into a p5.js artwork with seeded variation and user controls.
actual_capabilities: Creates an algorithmic philosophy before implementation.
Builds p5.js generative artwork with reproducible seeds.
Uses a provided HTML viewer template for consistent controls and layout.
Adds sliders, color controls, and seed navigation for exploration.
Produces a single browser-ready HTML artifact with inline art logic.
Guides original art creation instead of copying named artists.
limitations: Requires browser support for p5.js and loaded web fonts when using the default template.
Does not include a local image generation model or rendering backend.
Quality depends on the clarity of the creative brief and implementation time.
Large particle counts or complex animations may need performance tuning.

use_cases.title: Prototype Generative Visuals
use_cases.description: Create reproducible p5.js sketches with parameters for fast creative exploration.

use_cases.title: Build Interactive Artifacts
use_cases.description: Deliver browser-ready art experiences with seed controls, sliders, and download actions.

use_cases.title: Teach Computational Aesthetics
use_cases.description: Show how concepts like noise, particles, fields, and parameters become visual systems.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Simple Artwork
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a first generative art piece.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an original p5.js generative artwork about calm ocean currents. Include a short algorithmic philosophy and an interactive HTML artifact.

prompt_templates.title: Add Tunable Parameters
prompt_templates.prompt: Create algorithmic art based on migrating light fields. Add controls for particle count, flow strength, trail length, color warmth, and seed navigation.

prompt_templates.title: Explore Seed Variations
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a generative artwork with seeded randomness. Highlight five strong seed values and explain how each variation changes the composition.

prompt_templates.title: Translate a Conceptual Brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Turn this brief into an algorithmic philosophy and p5.js artifact: hidden infrastructure, delayed signals, and order emerging from noisy constraints.

output_examples.input: Create generative art inspired by wind moving through tall grass.
output_examples.output: A concise philosophy about field motion, followed by an interactive artwork with seeded grass agents, wind strength, density, and palette controls.

output_examples.input: Make an abstract system about city traffic at night.
output_examples.output: A browser-ready visual system with moving light paths, intersection rules, reproducible seeds, and controls for congestion, glow, and flow speed.

output_examples.input: I need a gallery piece about mineral growth.
output_examples.output: A generative crystallization concept with cell relaxation, layered color, seed navigation, and export support for finished compositions.

best_practices: Describe the desired mood, subject, and interaction needs before asking for code.
Use seed values to compare variations and preserve favorite compositions.
Keep parameter ranges focused so exploration stays useful and performant.
anti_patterns: Asking the skill to copy a living artist or a protected artwork style.
Requesting many unrelated visual systems in one artifact.
Removing seeded randomness when reproducible outputs are required.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates an algorithmic philosophy and a p5.js interactive artwork in a single HTML artifact.

faq.question: Can the artwork be reproduced?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill emphasizes seeded randomness so the same seed can recreate the same composition.

faq.question: Does it need a server?
faq.answer: No. The generated HTML is designed to open directly in a browser or AI artifact viewer.

faq.question: Can users adjust the art?
faq.answer: Yes. The template supports seed controls, sliders, optional color pickers, reset, regenerate, and download actions.

faq.question: Does it copy existing artists?
faq.answer: No. The instructions direct the model to create original algorithmic art and avoid copying existing work.

faq.question: What tools is it best for?
faq.answer: It is useful with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code when creating browser-based generative art artifacts.
